name: glass-logo
title: Glass Logo
description: OGL WebGL2 glass lens over an animated procedural swirl — silhouette driven by an SVG SDF.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/glass-logo-element.ts";

const svgLogo = `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="white"/></svg>`;
</script>

<template>
  <motion-glass-logo
    :svg-source="svgLogo"
    :speed="1"
    :scale="1"
    :rotation="0"
    :refraction="1"
    :chromatic-aberration="1"
    :blur="1"
    swirl-color-a="#222326"
    swirl-color-b="#ff6900"
    class="w-full h-[400px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/glass-logo-element.js"></script>

<motion-glass-logo
  svg-source="<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='white'/></svg>"
  speed="1"
  scale="1"
  rotation="0"
  refraction="1"

  blur="1"

props.name: svg-source
props.description: SVG markup to render as a glass lens (defaults to a logo shape).

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the swirl background.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale of the logo within the canvas.

props.name: offset-x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the logo center.

props.name: offset-y
props.description: Vertical offset of the logo center.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation angle of the logo in degrees.

props.name: refraction
props.description: Strength of the glass lens refraction effect.

props.name: chromatic-aberration
props.description: Intensity of RGB color splitting at edges.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur amount of the refracted background.

props.name: swirl-color-a
props.description: First color for the animated swirl gradient.

props.name: swirl-color-b
props.description: Second color for the animated swirl gradient.
